LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileA.label: planar glass
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileA.description: A smooth ground plane from a folded pocket of unstable space.
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileB.label: planar shale
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileB.description: A darker plate of condensed planar matter.
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileC.label: planar bloomstone
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileC.description: A translucent planar surface threaded with soft arcane color.
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileD.label: planar duskplate
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarTileD.description: A dense planar plate that drinks in ordinary light.
LanguageData.MFV_ManaRiverDeep.label: deep mana current
LanguageData.MFV_ManaRiverDeep.description: A luminous stream of condensed planar mana. Its surface moves like water, but the current carries arcane charge instead of ordinary silt.
LanguageData.MFV_ManaRiverShallow.label: shallow mana current
LanguageData.MFV_ManaRiverShallow.description: A thin layer of moving planar mana, bright enough to stain nearby ground with violet-blue light.
LanguageData.MFV_ManaRiverBank.label: mana-washed bank
LanguageData.MFV_ManaRiverBank.description: Planar stone washed smooth by nearby mana currents.
